description: Cinema-diegetic transition emulating a 35mm projector reel-change cue dot — brief flicker + warm bloom + characteristic projector buzz. Native to cinema-abandonado-style settings.

ffmpeg_params.cue_start_ms: Set = (duration(clip_a) * 1000) - 500. Projector cue lands across the seam, lingering into clip_b.

audio_recipe: projector-cue.mp3 (1.0s buzz/click) at volume 0.45 layered over a 1.0s crossfade of base audio. The buzz tails into clip_b establishing diegetic projection.
avoid_for: Reels with cuts/min target >5 (1.0s is too heavy)
hyperframes_alternative: GSAP: white-bloom div opacity 0→1→0 over 1.0s, eq filter on .scene-image tweening saturation up briefly. projector-cue.mp3 scheduled at scene change t.
validated_against_canonical_refs: cinema-abandonado internal use (NOT canonical authority — see hard rule #19)
validated_notes: Built from cinema-abandonado/sfx/projection_film_transition.mp3 (1.0s). Not validated against F1 canonical referents (no cinema sub-genre in F1 set). Use with manual QA + Gemini holistic review per video.
